name: Campaign creation, board, and pipeline run
description: A lead can create a campaign from a brief and read its board; running the campaign executes the multi-agent pipeline and returns tasks that carry pipeline status and owners.

planSteps.description: GET {base_url}/api/v1/team/members and capture a lead member id for the X-Member-Id header used on all subsequent requests.

POST {base_url}/api/v1/team/campaigns with the lead X-Member-Id header and JSON body {"name":"TestSprite loop backend campaign","template":"general","brief":{"product_name":"ReelMatrix","product_description":"AI marketing copilot","target_audience":"engineering leaders","marketing_goal":"awareness"}}.
Verify the response is 200 and returns a board with a 'campaign' (non-empty id and the given name), a 'tasks' array, and a non-empty 'members' array. Capture the campaign id.
GET {base_url}/api/v1/team/campaigns with the lead X-Member-Id header.
Verify the response is 200 and the returned list includes a campaign whose id equals the captured campaign id.
GET {base_url}/api/v1/team/campaigns/{campaign_id}/board with the lead X-Member-Id header.
Verify the response is 200 and returns the campaign board; every task has a 'status' drawn from the pipeline statuses and a 'kind', and the board's members list is non-empty.
POST {base_url}/api/v1/team/campaigns/{campaign_id}/run with the lead X-Member-Id header.
Verify the response is 200 and returns a board whose 'tasks' array is non-empty, with at least one task carrying generated output or a non-plan status (the pipeline advanced the board).
